{{Quote|There is a civil war going on, if you hadn't noticed. Supplies and equipment are going to be in short supply for the civilian population. The Darklighters saw this coming and have been accumulating a cache of supplies to help get though these times.|[[Draci]]|<ref name="SWG:DC" />}}
The '''Darklighter cache''', also known as the '''Darklighter cave''', was a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Located near the [[Darklighter estate]], it was used by the [[Darklighter family/Legends|Darklighter family]] as a cache.<ref name="SWG:DC" />

==History==
{{Quote|Desert Demons. I couldn't do anything to stop them, and they are cleaning the place out.|Draci|<ref name="SWG:DC" />}}
[[File:DarklighterCache2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The interior of the Darklighter cache.]]
Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the cave was overtaken by [[Desert Demons]]. [[Draci]], the guard of the cache, tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with clearing the cave and accessing its five inventory terminals in under fifteen [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]]. The spacer succeeded, thus effectively restoring the cache for the Darklighters.<ref name="SWG:DC" />

Around the same time, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] sadistic [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV-series supervisor droid]] [[EV-9D9/Legends|EV-9D9]] tasked an individual with destroying three [[Droid/Legends|droids]] who escaped Jabba's Palace and took refuge within the cave. These droids included an [[R3-series astromech droid/Legends|R3-series astromech droid]] named [[R3-B57]], a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] named [[BD-34]], and an [[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|RA-7 protocol droid]] named [[RA-316]]. According to EV-9D9's punitive instructions, the spacer planted pain bolts to the droids before destroying them.<ref name="SWG:R">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Runaways|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Darklighter cache was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Darklighter cache was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
